description: Listed Building Consent for Refurbishment, alteration and partial internal reconfiguration of the building. Erection of six roof windows, riser and plant. Creating toilets and storage rooms on each floor, installation of cycle storage on ground floor. Creating two offices on the first & second floor. Alterations to the garden terrace and fourth floor terrace. Relocating the fire escape. Changing existing windows and doors. New external wall light, rainwater pipe, lighting and metal plate for structural support.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].

Condition : 3 - Mortar details

The mortar mix and pointing details to be used in the construction shall be in line with those approved by planning permission 00074/C/P12(3) on 24 February 2023.

Condition : 4 - Windows details
The window details of the replacement windows and comprehensive methodology for the repair, removal and replacement of windows shall be constructed in accordance with those approved by planning permission 00074/C/P12(4) on 16 January 2023.

Condition : 5 - Material strip details
The details of the soft strip and other surveys (list) shall be in line with those approved by planning permission 00074/C/P12(5) on 13 January 2023.

Condition : 6 - External materials
No works shall take place until samples of the materials (including bricks, doors, lift overrun, rainwater pipe, structural plate and any other materials to be used in the external elevations of the development) of the works hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details.
